verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online has a documented V3 REST API, official SDKs and an official MCP server, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths on developer.intuit.com all returned 404. SDKs and MCP tool definitions are adjacent building blocks, not a published API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
